title.narrative: Amazon Dossier - Part II: Incidence and social awareness of the problem

description.narrative: The objective of the proposal is to raise awareness among society and the Brazilian State about the urgent need to create and implement truly efficient public policies for the task of guaranteeing the safety of journalists and communicators who work in the Amazon region. For society, this will be done by encouraging the production of reports on the topic by vehicles preferably from the Amazon, which will be financed by IVH and will have their publicity guaranteed through press relations strategies and partnerships with media outlets with a local reach, regional and national. For the Brazilian State, this will be done through advocacy actions, focusing on dialogue with the Program for the Protection of Human Rights Defenders, Communicators and Environmentalists (PPDDH) and with the Observatory of Violence against Journalists and Social Communicators.
